meta.description:
* Based on the game by Cherry Soft

The One-Eyed Devil accepts a depraved commission: break two captured princesses into first-class pleasure slaves before their kingdoms can mount a rescue.

In his torture chamber, the sheltered Princess Sakuya of Jilphan, a girl raised only to die as a war sacrifice, is stripped of her innocence and taught to chase the "Land of Dreams," while the proud Princess Milte schemes to escape and pays a degrading price for her defiance.

As the pirate's cruel lessons sink in, the line between torment and desire begins to dissolve.

Studio: Discovery
